g.title: Pipe(bevy_state::state::transitions::last_transition<demo::game_flow::AppState>, bevy_state::state::transitions::run_enter<demo::game_flow::AppState>) · 组合系统先执行前一阶段，将其输出作为后一阶段输入；此实例连接 last_transition<demo::game_flow::AppState> → run_enter<demo::game_flow::AppState>。
